description: Creates, changes, or deletes a note in Apple Notes. action: create (title, text, folder), append (id, text: added at the end), replace (id, text: everything below the title), edit (id, find: an exact passage in one paragraph, text: its replacement), rename (id, title), move (id, folder: made if it doesn't exist, as for create), delete (id: moves the note to Recently Deleted for 30 days), create_folder (folder), delete_folder (folder: deletes that folder, its notes to Recently Deleted; not the default folder). Text is Markdown-like: # headings, - lists, 1. numbered lists; - [ ] and - [x] become ☐ and ☑ lines. Notes with checklists, links, or images can't be changed (rewriting them would lose those); create a new note instead.

find.description: For edit: the exact passage to replace

folder.description: For create and move: the folder (made if it doesn't exist; create uses the default folder if left out); for create_folder and delete_folder: the folder

id.description: The note's id, from notes_find (not for create)

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

title.description: For create and rename: the note's title

name: notes_change
title: Change Notes
